title: Heather Ward
summary: A Philadelphia-based Division Agent who joins Caleb Dunne's Extremis Malis investigation into the Founders and Mantis's arms operation.

claims.text: Extremis Malis introduces Heather Ward as a Division Agent working in Philadelphia.
Ward works with Caleb Dunne against the Founders and the arms network linked to Mantis.

paragraphs.text: Ward gives the story its Philadelphia Division perspective. Her partnership with Caleb connects a local settlement dispute to the broader operation Mantis is running on behalf of Black Tusk.

verification.notes: This record covers only the character's licensed-comic role; it does not make a broader game-continuity claim.
